aptitude.rule: Aptitude modifies development rate only. It never directly grants current capability and never sets a hard maximum on learned stats.

capability.rule: Attributes, martial disciplines, professional skills, Qi and Qi Control are uncapped.

current_scale.attributes: 0-20 child/severely undeveloped; 20-40 weak; 40-60 ordinary trained adult; 60-75 strong; 75-90 elite; 90-100 extraordinary; >100 rare later development.
current_scale.skills: 1-20 beginner; 20-45 junior; 45-70 competent; 65-90 senior; 85-100 elite; 100-110 master; 110-120 exceptional specialist; 120+ rare world-class specialization.
current_scale.qi: 0-20 little cultivation; 20-50 junior; 50-80 established; 80-110 senior; 100-130 elite; 120-160 major master; 160+ extremely rare.

martial_disciplines.sword: Jian, Dao, Long Dao, Short Sword and Dagger.
martial_disciplines.spear: Spear, Short Spear, Staff and Glaive.
martial_disciplines.unarmed: Striking, clinch, grappling, throws and joint control.
martial_disciplines.stealth_scouting: Concealment, tracking, reconnaissance, ambush fieldcraft and route observation.
martial_disciplines.command: Tactical control, delegation, synchronization, reserves, withdrawal and formation cohesion.

base_attributes.strength: Force production, load handling, bracing and grappling support.
base_attributes.dexterity: Fine motor control, weapon handling and rapid body adjustment.
base_attributes.endurance: Sustained exertion, fatigue resistance and work capacity.
base_attributes.perception: Sensory recognition, spatial reading and threat acquisition.
base_attributes.intelligence: Planning, learning, analysis and professional reasoning.
base_attributes.willpower: Composure, pain tolerance, persistence and resistance to panic.
